Structure Type: Two-Story Data Center with Rooftop Mechanical Equipment Overall Footprint: 650 feet (length) x 450 feet (width) Building Use: Mission-critical data processing facility (data center) with associated mechanical electrical and cooling infrastructure. Number of Stories: 2 stories above finished grade. Primary Construction: Structural steel framing with reinforced concrete foundations and composite metal deck floor system. Exterior envelope consists of insulated metal wall panels and precast concrete wall 
panels. Rooftop Equipment: The roof will support mechanical and electrical equipment associated with data center operations including: Air-handling units (AHUs) Cooling towers or dry coolers Condenser units Electrical equipment and associated screening structures Piping racks and service platforms Maintenance access walkways and guardrails All rooftop 
equipment will be mounted on structural steel dunnage frames anchored to the building structure. Approximate Height: Building roof height: -40-45 feet above finished grade Rooftop equipment height: approximately 10-20 feet above roof surface Total overall height: approximately 55-65 feet above finished grade Roof Type: Flat roof with parapet and internal drainage system. Site Context: The structure will be located within a secured industrial campus and is part of a larger data center development consisting of multiple buildings electrical yards and support infrastructure. Lighting: Structure will not require obstruction lighting unless determined necessary by the FAA during 
aeronautical evaluation.
